name: Barbell Wrist Curl
summary: A seated curl that moves only the wrists to train the forearm flexors, which help your grip strength.
setup: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your forearms on your thighs or the bench with the wrists hanging past the edge.
Choose a light load so you can control the full range.
execution: Let the bar roll down toward your fingertips, keeping the forearms still.
Curl the hands back up by flexing the wrists as far as you can.
Lower slowly and repeat for all reps.
mistakes: Lifting the forearms off the bench: keep them supported and flat.
Using too much weight and bouncing: lower the load and slow down.
Cutting the range short: use the full stretch and squeeze each rep.
Gripping too hard at the fingertips: let the bar roll down only as far as you can control.
